name: Skrimm
tagline: Turn your workforce's gaming habit into a KPI you can actually defend.
positioning: Skrimm is the coaching layer for enterprise esports programs — measurable rep, VOD review, and coach hours billed only when your players actually show up.

hero.h1: Coaching for teams that queue up on the clock.
hero.sub: Skrimm plugs professional esports coaches into your org's rosters, tracks every rep, and only bills for the minutes your players actually train. No idle retainers. No vibes-based invoices.

features.title: VOD review that names names
features.description: Frame-tagged demo breakdowns land in each player's inbox within an hour of the match. Every death gets a note. Every note gets an owner.

features.title: Coaches on tap
features.description: Route rosters to tier-verified coaches by title, region, and rank. Skrimm handles scheduling, NDAs, and the awkward 'who's late' conversation.

features.title: Rep meter, not seat license
features.description: We meter live coaching minutes, reviewed VOD, and completed drills. If nobody trained this week, your bill says zero. Radical.

features.title: Rank telemetry, exported
features.description: Ladder movement, aim benchmarks, and comms scores stream to your BI stack via API. Put esports on the same dashboard as everything else.

features.title: Roster governance
features.description: SSO, per-title spend caps, and audit logs so your finance team stops treating the gaming budget like a rounding error.

features.title: Playbook library
features.description: Reusable drill packs and map protocols per title. Onboard a new hire's rank grind in a day, not a season.

testimonials.quote: We were paying three retainer coaches to watch our team lose politely. Skrimm bills by the rep, so now the coaches are motivated and I have a spreadsheet that survives audit season.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: The frame-tagged VOD notes ended every 'I thought you had that angle' argument on our internal roster. Painful for morale. Great for winrate.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferreira

testimonials.quote: I approved the pilot as a joke line item. Six weeks later esports had cleaner telemetry than half our engineering teams. Now it's a board slide.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For pilots and one roster testing whether this is real.
For orgs running multiple rosters across titles that expect receipts.
For enterprises standardizing esports across regions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Skrimm meters the reps, not the retainer. Coaching your workforce actually shows up for — billed by the minute, defended by the dashboard.
